title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Arca, Inc.; Notice of Filing of Proposed Rule Change To List and Trade Shares of the Truth Social Bitcoin and Ethereum ETF, B.T. Under NYSE Arca Rule 8.201-E (Commodity-Based Trust Shares)
summary: On 10 July 2025, the Federal Register published an SEC notice that NYSE Arca had filed a proposed rule change (File No. SR-NYSEARCA-2025-45, filed 24 June 2025) to list and trade shares of the Truth Social Bitcoin and Ethereum ETF, B.T. under NYSE Arca Rule 8.201-E, the exchange's Commodity-Based Trust Shares listing standard. The trust's sponsor is Yorkville America Digital, LLC, a Florida limited liability company; according to the registration statement, the trust is a passive investment vehicle seeking to reflect generally the price performance of bitcoin and ether, initially allocated between the two at approximately a three-to-one ratio by value. Publication opened a public comment period under Exchange Act Section 19(b)(1); the notice itself takes no position on how the SEC will ultimately act on the proposal.
why_it_matters: This is the same procedural first step the SEC requires before it can approve, disapprove, or open formal proceedings on any proposed crypto exchange-traded product listing: publishing the exchange's proposal and inviting public comment. The notice takes no position on, and does not resolve, whether the SEC will ultimately allow this particular bitcoin-and-ether product to list.
